purpose: Episode 54 stage-level Gemini semantic grouping, translation, and text proofread. The registered root calls stage.split/run, stage.translate/run, and stage.text_proofread/run. Offline replay does not open a socket.
input_identity: baseline B upstream manifests for episode 54; read-only; not this run's ASR chain
allowed_variable: REAL_LLM_STAGES_ONLINE=1 selects the explicit online grant; unset stays offline. REAL_CHAIN_BIND_UPSTREAM, when set, makes the same root call run_bound instead of run
repetitions: online runs each stage twice when the first pass is not a deterministic stop; offline runs once with zero requests
failure_policy: deterministic HTTP 400 or 401 stops that stage with no further retries; transient failures stay inside the legacy limited retry; MiMo is not requested
randomness: provider text may vary; semantic merge temperature is 0 and translation temperature is the legacy 0.3
oracle: offline attempts stay 0; online sends gemini-3.8-flash-high and does not claim the old gemini-3.8-flash alias is equivalent
not_accepted: requests under an online grant whose network flag is false
